text: Diversification: Simple Example (TSP) Context @ Problem: Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) @ Solution representation: a tour (permutation of cities) @ Move: 2-opt edge exchange Observation from frequency memory o Edge (B, C) appears in most accepted tours o Edge (D, E) is rarely used Diversification step @ Penalize frequent components: moves that keep edge (B, C) receive an added cost penalty o Encourage rare components: prefer moves that introduce edge (D, E) Effect @ Search is pushed away from the current region @ New tour structures are explored @ Previously unseen basins become reachable
